content.text: Section 11 is directly on point and meets (and largely exceeds) the checklist. No redline needed.

input.quote: 11.1 Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form.
input.rationale: Section 11 satisfies the preferred position on its material terms and comfortably clears the fallback: assistance is triggered by expiry or termination for any reason (not conditioned on a pre-expiry request or on Customer being non-breaching), runs up to six months (well beyond the 90-day fallback), Customer Data is returned within thirty days in a complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format with metadata, and an authorized officer certifies deletion in writing after Customer confirms successful return. Two variances are in our favour and are noted rather than flagged: assistance is priced at the rates in the expiring Order Form rather than Vendor's then-current rates (rate protection for us), and the thirty-day return clock runs from our request rather than from termination, with Vendor expressly barred from withholding Customer Data over a fee dispute. Section 15 contains no conflicting immediate-deletion mechanic, and Section 16.3 confirms Customer Data remains governed by Sections 11 and 15.
